supported: Siya mismo ang nagtitinda at kinumpirma ng market office na wala siyang assigned vendor ID.
compliant: Tiningnan ang ID ng nagtitinda. Valid ito at sa kanya nakapangalan.
insufficient: May ID sa puwesto pero hindi natiyak kung nakapangalan sa taong nagtitinda.

supported: The active seller showed an expired market identification card.
compliant: The person handling sales showed a current card assigned to her.
insufficient: The cashier's badge was turned around. Its validity and holder could not be checked.

supported: Ang permit ay para lang sa gulay pero nagtitinda ng isda ang vendor, at walang hiwalay na permit ayon sa licensing office.
compliant: May permit ang vendor na sakop ang parehong gulay at isda na ibinebenta niya.
insufficient: Sa gulay ang permit pero hindi pa malinaw kung ano ang isa pang ibinebenta sa tindahan.

supported: The vendor continued serving meals after the business permit expired.
compliant: The meal stall presented a valid business permit covering its current activity.
insufficient: The food stall's permit was requested. Its expiry and coverage are still unverified.

supported: Inaalok pa sa mga bumibili ang mga de-latang paso na ang expiration date.
compliant: May de-latang paso sa hiwalay na kahon na pang-disposal. Inalis na sa bentahan ang lahat ng apektadong lata.
insufficient: Mukhang paso ang mga lata pero burado ang petsa at hindi pa na-check kung ibinebenta ang mga ito.

supported: The stallholder offered spoiled fish for sale. The inspector observed a strong rotten smell and slimy flesh.
compliant: The inspector checked the fish offered for sale and found it fresh and properly chilled.
insufficient: A shopper reported a rotten smell near the fish aisle. Its source and the condition of the fish were unverified.

supported: A calibrated 2 kg check weight was placed on the vendor's scale, which read 1.8 kg.
compliant: The vendor's scale displayed 2,000 g with a calibrated 2 kg reference mass on it.
insufficient: A 2 kg reference was used but its calibration was unverified and the scale reading was not recorded.

supported: Ibinenta bilang 3 kg ang bigas pero 2.7 kg lang nang tinimbang sa verified na timbangan.
compliant: Ang bigas na nakalagay na 3 kg ay 3000 g nang timbangin sa verified na timbangan.
insufficient: May reklamo na kulang ang 3 kg ng bigas pero wala pang aktuwal na timbang.

supported: The vendor plugged a cooking appliance into the corridor outlet despite the posted restriction reserving it for cleaners.
compliant: The cooking appliance ran from the stall's own approved outlet and the corridor outlet was unused.
insufficient: An extension cord crossed the corridor but its origin and load were unclear.

supported: Gumagamit ang tindero ng halogen lamp kahit LED lang ang pinapayagan sa seksyon.
compliant: LED ang ilaw ng stall gaya ng hinihingi ng nakapaskil na patakaran.
insufficient: May mainit na ilaw sa stall pero hindi na-check ang uri o kung sakop ng pagbabawal.

supported: Ibang tao ang namamahala at nagbebenta sa puwesto. Kinumpirma ng market office na hindi siya awardee o awtorisadong helper.
compliant: Ang awardee mismo ang gumagamit ng puwesto, kasama ang helper na nakalista sa market office.
insufficient: Ibang tao ang nasa counter pero hindi pa na-check kung rehistradong helper siya.

supported: The stallholder sold from an adjoining unit that the award expressly excluded.
compliant: The award included both adjoining units and the vendor used only those units.
insufficient: Crates were seen in the vacant adjoining unit. Who was using it and the award boundaries were unverified.

supported: Walang fire extinguisher sa stall kahit nakasaad sa kontrata na kailangang maglagay ang stallholder.
compliant: Nakita at na-check ang gumaganang extinguisher sa stall gaya ng nasa kontrata.
insufficient: Hindi makita ang extinguisher mula sa pasilyo. Hindi pa nasuri ang loob o ang tungkulin ng stallholder.

supported: The stallholder left the stall unattended during trading despite the signed requirement to keep an attendant there.
compliant: The attendant named on the duty sheet was at the counter throughout the check.
insufficient: The stall looked unattended from the aisle. The back counter and applicable duty were unchecked.

supported: Nagpatayo ng permanenteng partition ang stallholder at kinumpirma ng market office na wala itong approval.
compliant: Ang bagong partition ay tugma sa aprubadong plano na sinuri ng inspector.
insufficient: May bagong partition pero hindi pa nakikita ang approved plan.

supported: The vendor installed a raised floor that is absent from the approved construction drawings.
compliant: The new floor matches the drawing and permit verified by the inspector.
insufficient: A platform is visible. It is unclear whether it is a permanent alteration or covered by approval.

supported: Kinabit ng vendor ang hose sa linya ng pamilihan. Kinumpirma ng maintenance na walang awtorisasyon ang connection.
compliant: Ang hose ng vendor ay nakakabit sa outlet na itinalaga at inaprubahan ng maintenance.
insufficient: May hose sa tabi ng water line. Hindi pa nasundan kung saan ito nakakabit o sino ang may gamit.

supported: The stallholder bypassed the water meter by installing a pipe upstream of it.
compliant: The inspector traced the stall's water line through its assigned meter and found no bypass.
insufficient: The pipe disappears behind the wall and the meter route has yet to be checked.

supported: Pinapaupahan ng vendor sa ibang tao ang stall. Napatunayan sa kontrata at records na wala siyang pahintulot na mag-sublet.
compliant: May nakasulat na pahintulot ng lessor para sa sublease at tugma sa rekord ang taong umuupa.
insufficient: May sinasabing subleasing si vendor pero hindi pa nasuri ang kasunduan o pahintulot.

supported: The stallholder transferred the lease for payment, and the lessor confirmed that consent required by the lease had never been given.
compliant: The lease transfer was approved in writing before the new tenant paid and took over.
insufficient: The occupant says he pays the previous tenant. The contract and transfer approval have yet to be checked.

supported: Nagbebenta ang vendor sa bangketa. Kinumpirma ng market office na wala siyang pahintulot para sa lokasyong iyon.
compliant: Nagbebenta ang vendor sa puwestong nasa kanyang balidong vending authorization.
insufficient: May nagbebenta sa bangketa pero hindi pa na-check ang pahintulot niya para roon.

supported: The hawker was serving customers outside her designated area and the office confirmed no temporary authorization for that spot.
compliant: The hawker sold inside the authorized area printed on her current pass.
insufficient: A mobile cart was in the restricted area. No sales were observed and the permit could not be checked.

supported: Nagsuntukan ang dalawang vendor at nagsara ang katabing puwesto dahil lumikas ang mga mamimili.
compliant: Nagkaroon ng mahinahong usapan sa pagitan ng dalawang vendor at tuloy ang bentahan at daloy ng mamimili.
insufficient: May nagsabing may away ng mga vendor pero hindi nakita kung sino o kung may nagambalang bentahan.

supported: The vendor's loud shouting forced the adjacent counter to stop serving and buyers to leave the row.
compliant: The vendor called out prices at a normal level and nearby counters continued serving without disruption.
insufficient: Noise was reported. The source and its effect on market operations were not established.

supported: Nakita ng inspektor na umiinom ng beer ang vendor sa loob ng market kahit bawal ang pag-inom doon.
compliant: Ang laman ng baso ng vendor ay juice na kinumpirma ng inspektor. Walang alak na ininom o inihain.
insufficient: May basong amoy alak sa stall pero hindi matukoy kung sino ang uminom o kung alak talaga iyon.

supported: The inspector watched the stallholder pour and serve gin inside the market, where the posted rule prohibits liquor service.
compliant: The stallholder served sealed soda and the inspector saw no liquor being served.
insufficient: A shopper mentioned liquor service but the beverage and the person serving it were not verified.

supported: Tinakot ng vendor ang mamimili na hindi siya pauuwiin hangga't hindi siya bibili.
compliant: Nag-alok ang vendor ng produkto at pinayagang umalis ang mamimili matapos itong tumanggi.
insufficient: May nagsabing tinakot siya sa palengke pero hindi natukoy ang vendor o ang sinabi.

supported: The inspector saw the stallholder grab a customer's wrist and demand payment before releasing her.
compliant: The stallholder returned the goods and let the customer leave after she declined the purchase.
insufficient: A customer said the seller was rude. No specific act or words were documented.

supported: Nag-iwan ang vendor ng mga kahon sa gitna ng pasilyo kaya hindi makadaan ang mga mamimili.
compliant: Nasa loob ng marka ng stall ang mga kahon at maluwag ang daanan.
insufficient: May kahon sa gilid ng daan pero hindi pa malinaw kung nakaharang ito o kung kanino ito.

supported: The vendor left a trolley across the emergency exit, preventing the door from opening.
compliant: The trolley was inside the marked storage bay and the emergency exit opened fully.
insufficient: A trolley was seen near the exit. The clearance and the person who put it there were unverified.

supported: Nagtitinda ang vendor nang walang apron kahit kailangan ito sa food stall.
compliant: Suot ng nagtitinda ang apron na kailangan para sa food stall.
insufficient: May tao sa likod ng counter na walang apron. Hindi malinaw kung siya ang nagtitinda.

supported: The seller handled food while wearing a sando in a section where sellers must wear a shirt covering the torso.
compliant: The inspector checked that the seller wore the required shirt while serving customers.
insufficient: The seller was seen on a break. His attire while serving customers was not observed.

supported: Iniwan ng vendor ang kutsilyo sa bukas na counter matapos magsara, kahit kailangang ikandado kapag hindi ginagamit.
compliant: Naka-lock sa lalagyan ang kutsilyo ng vendor matapos magsara.
insufficient: May kutsilyo sa counter. Hindi pa natiyak kung ginagamit ito o kung sakop ng storage rule.

supported: The stallholder carried an uncovered cleaver into another row despite the rule requiring an opaque cover during transport.
compliant: The stallholder transported the cleaver inside a closed opaque sheath.
insufficient: A blade was reported outside the stall but its cover and who carried it were unverified.

supported: Ipinarada ng delivery driver ng vendor ang van sa may karatulang bawal magparada.
compliant: Sa minarkahang delivery bay ipinarada ang van at pinapayagan ang parking doon.
insufficient: May van sa dulo ng lane pero hindi na-check ang karatula o kung nakaparada ito roon.

supported: The vendor's truck entered the one-way market lane southbound where the posted arrow allows northbound traffic only.
compliant: The delivery vehicle followed the posted northbound direction through the market lane.
insufficient: A truck was seen on the access road. Its direction and the applicable lane rule were unverified.

supported: Naniningil ang kargador ng 50 piso sa isang sako kahit 30 piso ang nakapaskil na rate para sa parehong karga.
compliant: Sinuri ang bayad na 30 piso para sa isang sako at tugma ito sa rate ng kargador.
insufficient: Sabi ng mamimili mataas ang singil ng kargador pero hindi naitala ang bayad o bilang ng karga.

supported: The man was taking paid porter jobs and the market office confirmed he had no current porter registration.
compliant: The porter doing paid work appeared on the current roster under his own ID.
insufficient: Someone carried sacks. It is unclear whether he was working as a porter and the roster was not checked.

supported: Nagpa-raffle ang vendor pero hindi ibinigay sa nanalo ang premyong nakasaad sa approved mechanics.
compliant: Ibinigay ng vendor sa nanalo ang eksaktong premyong nasa approved mechanics ng raffle.
insufficient: May reklamong iba ang premyo. Hindi pa nasuri ang approved mechanics o natanggap ng nanalo.

supported: The vendor ran a tasting booth where prior promotion approval is required and the office confirmed none was granted.
compliant: The tasting booth operated under a current approval for that exact location.
insufficient: A tasting table was seen but no sampling was observed and approval was not checked.

supported: Nagpamahagi ng flyers ang vendor sa pasilyo kahit kailangan ng permit at kinumpirmang wala siyang approval.
compliant: Sakop ng valid distribution approval ang flyers na ipinamigay ng vendor sa pasilyo.
insufficient: May nakitang flyers sa pasilyo pero hindi matukoy kung sino ang namigay at kung may approval.

supported: The vendor copied shoppers' phone numbers to send advertisements without the consent required by the posted policy.
compliant: The vendor sent ads only to shoppers who expressly signed the marketing consent form.
insufficient: The vendor kept a list of numbers. Its purpose and customer consent were unverified.

supported: Nakabit pa ang tarpaulin ng vendor matapos ang petsa ng pagtatanggal na nasa permit.
compliant: Tinanggal ang tarpaulin bago matapos ang approved display period.
insufficient: May nakasabit na tarpaulin pero hindi pa nasuri kung hanggang kailan ang permit.

supported: The vendor's sign projected 70 cm into the corridor against an approval limit of 40 cm.
compliant: The sign projected 35 cm, within the approved maximum of 40 cm.
insufficient: The sign appears to project into the corridor. Its projection and approval limit were not measured.

supported: Nagpatugtog at nagpa-karaoke ang stallholder sa market event kahit kinumpirma ng office na walang kinakailangang event approval.
compliant: Nag-karaoke ang stallholder sa petsa at lokasyong sakop ng current event approval.
insufficient: May speaker at mikropono sa stall pero walang aktuwal na event na nakita at hindi na-check ang approval.

supported: The vendor's stage show continued until 9 pm although its permit required it to end at 7 pm.
compliant: The vendor's stage show ended at 6:45 pm before the approved 7 pm cutoff.
insufficient: A show was reported to run late. The actual end time and permit condition were not established.

supported: Patay ang ilaw sa ibabaw ng puwesto at nakasaad sa kontrata na stallholder ang dapat mag-maintain ng fixture.
compliant: Gumagana ang fixture na nakatalaga sa stallholder sa kontrata nang i-test ito.
insufficient: Patay ang ilaw pero hindi pa alam kung market maintenance o ang vendor ang may tungkulin dito.

supported: The stallholder's assigned emergency lamp failed during the test, and the signed duty roster makes him responsible for that fixture.
compliant: The assigned emergency lamp lit during the test and the stallholder's maintenance log was current.
insufficient: The emergency lamp looked dim. No functional check or responsibility assignment was verified.

supported: Nakitang ginawang tulugan ng vendor ang stall gabi-gabi kahit bawal gamitin ang stall bilang tirahan.
compliant: Ginagamit ng vendor ang stall sa bentahan lang at walang tumitira roon, gaya ng hinihingi ng market rule.
insufficient: May kumot sa stall pero hindi napatunayang may tumitira roon.

supported: The stallholder let his dog roam loose between stalls despite the posted restriction on loose animals.
compliant: The vendor's dog was secured in the permitted area under the posted animal rule.
insufficient: A loose dog was seen, but its owner and any connection to a stallholder were unverified.

supported: Sa test buy, 90 piso ang siningil ng vendor sa item na may tag na 75 piso, parehong item at unit ayon sa resibo.
compliant: Tugma ang 75 piso sa tag at ang 75 piso sa resibo para sa parehong item.
insufficient: Sabi ng buyer 90 piso ang binayaran pero wala pang resibo o beripikadong tag para sa item.

supported: The inspector found no visible price on the vendor's goods even though the posted rule required price display.
compliant: The vendor displayed a legible price on every item subject to the posted display requirement.
insufficient: The tags were unreadable from the aisle and the items had not been checked up close.

supported: Kinumpirma ng ledger na hindi binayaran ng vendor ang market fee na due na noong nakaraang linggo.
compliant: Tugma ang resibo at ledger na bayad nang buo at nasa oras ang market fee.
insufficient: Walang resibo ang vendor sa ngayon. Hindi pa na-reconcile ang koleksiyon sa ledger.

supported: The verified ledger showed the stallholder paid only 80 pesos of the required 100 peso inspection fee.
compliant: The receipt and collection record both confirm payment of the full 100 peso inspection fee.
insufficient: A fee balance was reported. The amount due and actual payment remain unverified.

supported: Hinarang ng vendor ang awtorisadong inspektor para hindi nito ma-inspect ang stall.
compliant: Pinapasok ng vendor ang awtorisadong inspektor at nakumpleto ang inspeksiyon nang walang sagabal.
insufficient: Ayaw raw ipakita ang prangkisa pero hindi alam kung sino ang humingi o kung may awtorisadong inspeksiyon.

supported: The vendor shoved the inspector aside to prevent the issuance of a citation during an authorized inspection.
compliant: The vendor accepted the citation and allowed the inspector to finish documenting the stall.
insufficient: A dispute was reported near the stall. There is no verified act of interference or identified officer.

supported: Tuloy ang bentahan ng vendor kahit kumpirmado sa market office na may aktibong closure order sa stall.
compliant: Sarado ang puwesto at walang bentahan habang may bisa ang closure order.
insufficient: Bukas ang shutter pero walang nakitang bentahan at hindi pa natiyak kung aktibo ang order.

supported: The vendor resumed trading two days before the verified suspension ended.
compliant: The vendor resumed trading after the recorded suspension expired.
insufficient: The stall was open. The end date of the suspension and whether trading resumed are unverified.
